newsitem.title: INDIA: Kuoni picks up 51 pct stake in India SOTC.
newsitem.headline: Kuoni picks up 51 pct stake in India SOTC.

text.p: Kuoni Travel Holdings, a Zurich-based company, has acquired a 51 percent equity stake in India's SOTC Holiday Tours Pvt. Ltd, the firm's chief executive said on Friday.
"We are particularly impressed by the innovation and dynamism of SOTC and therefore we have specially negotiated for equity in this company," Gullotti Riccardo, Kuoni's chief executive officer said.
The $2.5 billion international travel major is one of Europe's largest tour operators. Its business includes tour operations, retailing and business travel.

The Bombay-based SOTC which specialises in packaged travel products holds a 70 percent of the market share in the Indian holiday market with sales networks in over 10 cities, a company statement said.
As per the agreement, Kuoni will provide its highly sophisticated on-line travel computer system to SOTC Kuoni, the new name of SOTC Holiday Tours.
"We now plan to come out with an initial public offering in the region of about 250 million rupees ," he told a press conference.
He did not give other details.
Company officials said Kuoni plans to fund SOTC Kuoni's infrastructure growth and build distribution networks in India.
The international travel group will offer information technology, human resource development and technology services to the new company.
